{{Top|leg}}
'''Star Tours Flight 83''' was the designation of a flight offered to passengers by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency on the [[Endor Express]] route. The flight was late arriving at the [[Tomorrowland Starport]] on the day of the [[Battle of Death Star III]].
